law_name: Law No. 75 of 1999 on the Protection of Literary and Artistic Property
term_of_protection: Author's life + 50 years (collective and audiovisual works: 50 years from end of year of publication)
fair_use_exceptions: Exhaustive list (arts. 23-34): private copying, teaching, public libraries
enforcement_body: Intellectual Property Protection Office - Ministry of Economy and Trade
